title: 96% of counties counted moved left since 2024
dek: Every county with a Senate or governor race on Tuesday, drawn as a block whose height is how far it moved from the Harris–Trump vote. 2,676 of 2,775 moved toward the Democrats, the typical one by 14 points; all 254 Texas counties did, Starr County by 72. Plus the night as it happened, seat by seat.

areas.title: The border counties that swung hardest
areas.dek: Starr County moved 72 points. The Rio Grande Valley and the counties along the border, which went for Trump two years ago, came back to the Democrats harder than anywhere else in the country.

areas.title: The Southeast: every county in four states, and most of Florida
areas.dek: Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Virginia moved left in every county. Florida moved too, even as it stayed red.

areas.title: The Midwest: Ohio, Iowa and Kansas flip
areas.dek: Three Senate seats Trump carried by double digits changed hands. The swing ran from the Great Lakes to the Kansas prairie, meatpacking towns included.

areas.title: The Deep South and Appalachia: the reddest counties moved too
areas.dek: Republicans held every seat here but Mississippi’s, and every county still moved toward the Democrats, most of them by 15 to 25 points.

areas.title: Where the map moved right
areas.dek: Only 99 counties moved toward the Republicans. They are in Vermont, Maine, upstate New York and a few corners of Maryland, and most of them have a governor to thank.

border.title: The wall, and the counties around it
border.dek: Every one of the 24 counties on the Mexican border moved toward the Democrats, Starr County by 72 points and the border as a whole by a median 29. In the state that redrew its map to send five more Republicans to Washington, the border is where the plan came apart.

states.name: Texas
states.title: Every Texas county moved left as Talarico broke the GOP's statewide streak
states.dek: James Talarico beat Ken Paxton by 12.1 points, a 25.8-point move from Donald Trump's 2024 margin. The swing ran from Paxton's own suburbs to the Panhandle. It was smallest in the reddest, least populous counties.
states.summary: Talarico won by 12.1 points; all 254 counties moved toward Democrats, led by South Texas and the big suburban counties.

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.title: All 67 Pennsylvania counties moved toward Shapiro, and 11 Trump counties flipped
states.dek: Gov. Josh Shapiro won a second term by 22 points, a 24-point move from Donald Trump's 2024 margin. The biggest moves came in the southwestern gas counties and the northeastern coal valleys. The smallest came in the most Republican rural counties.
states.summary: Shapiro won by 22 points; every county moved left, typically by 23 points, and 11 counties Trump carried flipped.

states.name: Rhode Island
states.title: Every Rhode Island county swings left; Reed wins sixth term by 37
states.dek: Sen. Jack Reed beat a little-known Republican by 37.5 points, 23.6 points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024. The biggest moves came in Providence County and in Kent County, which was the state's closest county two years ago.
states.summary: Reed's 37.5-point win moved all five counties left, led by Providence (+26) and Kent (+24), with turnout at 70% of 2024's.

states.name: Mississippi
states.title: In Mississippi, DeSoto and the Coast moved most as Colom edged Hyde-Smith
states.dek: All 82 Mississippi counties moved toward the Democrats. The biggest swings came in Republican suburbs and Gulf Coast counties where turnout fell. In the Black-majority Delta, turnout held but margins grew the least.
states.summary: Scott Colom beat Cindy Hyde-Smith by half a point; all 82 counties moved left, led by DeSoto's 30-point swing.

states.name: North Carolina
states.title: Every North Carolina county moved left as Roy Cooper won by nearly 20
states.dek: The former governor turned a state Donald Trump carried by 3 points into a 19.6-point Senate win. The shift was almost the same size in mountain hollows, exurbs and cities, and largest where turnout fell furthest.
states.summary: Roy Cooper won by 19.6 points; all 100 counties moved left, 21 flipped from Trump, and the shift was nearly uniform.

states.name: South Carolina
states.title: South Carolina's Republican Upstate moved furthest as Andrews took the Graham seat
states.dek: Every one of South Carolina's 46 counties moved toward the Democrats. Spartanburg and the Upstate's Republican strongholds moved the most. Hilton Head and the southern coast moved the least, and Republicans held the governor's office on the same ballot.
states.summary: All 46 counties moved left; Annie Andrews won by 4.5 points as Greenville, York and 11 other Trump counties flipped.

states.name: Hawaii
states.title: Josh Green's record win pushes every Hawaii county 20-plus points left
states.dek: Gov. Josh Green won a second term by 45 points, 22 points better than Kamala Harris did in Hawaii in 2024. Kauai moved the most. A quarter fewer ballots were cast, so lower turnout is part of the story.
states.summary: Green's 45-point reelection margin moved Hawaii 22 points left of 2024; Kauai led every county with a 29-point swing.

states.name: New Jersey
states.title: Booker's 27-point win moved all 21 New Jersey counties left
states.dek: Cory Booker turned Kamala Harris's 5.9-point 2024 margin into a 27-point win and carried seven counties Donald Trump had won. The biggest moves came where turnout fell furthest: Hudson, Passaic and Ocean.
states.summary: Booker won by 27.3 points, a 21-point move from 2024; all 21 counties moved left and seven Trump counties flipped.

states.name: West Virginia
states.title: Capito wins a third term as all 55 West Virginia counties move left
states.dek: Sen. Shelley Moore Capito won by about 20 points, half of Donald Trump's 2024 margin. Her Democratic challenger carried Charleston, Morgantown and Jefferson County, and the biggest shift came in Berkeley County in the Eastern Panhandle.
states.summary: Capito won by 20.4 points, down from Trump's 41.9; all 55 counties moved left, and three flipped Democratic.

states.name: Alabama
states.title: Every Alabama county moved left, and Barry Moore still won by nine
states.dek: Republican Barry Moore beat Everett Wess by 9.4 points, compared with Trump's 30.6 in 2024. Madison, Mobile and Tuscaloosa counties flipped. The Black Belt moved least, and turnout fell furthest in the northern hill country.
states.summary: All 67 counties moved toward Democrats; Barry Moore won the Senate seat by 9.4 points as six Trump counties flipped.

states.name: Kansas
states.title: Every Kansas county moved left; the southwest moved furthest
states.dek: Adam Hamilton beat Sen. Roger Marshall by 5.1 points in a state Donald Trump carried by 16.1, a 21-point move. Meatpacking counties hit by September immigration raids moved most; the governor's race is still uncalled.
states.summary: Hamilton won by 5.1 points; all 105 counties moved left, Seward by 52 points, and six Trump counties flipped.

states.name: New Mexico
states.title: Every New Mexico county moved left as Luján won by 26 points
states.dek: Sen. Ben Ray Luján beat a Republican who got on the ballot through write-in votes. Every county moved toward the Democrats and five Trump counties flipped, a bigger shift than in Deb Haaland's governor's race.
states.summary: Luján won by 26.5 points; all 33 counties moved left and five that Trump won in 2024 flipped.

states.name: Georgia
states.title: All 159 Georgia counties moved toward Ossoff, from Dalton to DeKalb
states.dek: Two years after Donald Trump carried Georgia, Jon Ossoff won a second Senate term by 18 points. The move reached every county, was largest in the north Georgia counties with many Hispanic residents and in the Atlanta suburbs, and was smallest in the southwest.
states.summary: Ossoff won Georgia by 18 points, a 20-point move from 2024, and all 159 counties moved toward the Democrats.

states.name: Louisiana
states.title: Every Louisiana parish moved left, but Julia Letlow held the Senate seat
states.dek: Democrat Jamie Davis, a Tensas Parish farmer, cut Donald Trump's 22-point margin to 1.8 and flipped eight parishes. Some of the biggest swings came in the Republican suburbs of New Orleans and Baton Rouge.
states.summary: Julia Letlow won by 1.8 points as all 64 parishes moved left, a 20-point swing from Trump's 2024 margin.

states.name: Arkansas
states.title: Cotton holds Arkansas as all 75 counties move toward the Democrats
states.dek: Tom Cotton won a third term by 11.9 points, compared with Donald Trump's 30.6 in 2024. The biggest shifts came in Northwest Arkansas, Jonesboro and De Queen. The smallest came in the Delta counties that already vote Democratic.
states.summary: Cotton won by 11.9 points, down from Trump's 30.6; all 75 counties moved left and Washington and Desha flipped.

states.name: Arizona
states.title: Every Arizona county swings toward Hobbs as Maricopa and Yuma flip
states.dek: Gov. Katie Hobbs beat Andy Biggs by 13 points, an 18.7-point swing from Donald Trump's 2024 win. All 15 counties moved toward the Democrats. Maricopa flipped, and so did Yuma, where the count is still partial.
states.summary: Hobbs wins by 13.1 points; all 15 counties move left, and Maricopa and Yuma flip from Trump.

states.name: Kentucky
states.title: Eastern Kentucky moved most as Barr held McConnell's seat by 12
states.dek: All 120 Kentucky counties moved toward Democrat Charles Booker compared with Donald Trump's 2024 margins, and Franklin County flipped. Republican Andy Barr still won by 12 points. The mountain counties moved the most, and Lake Cumberland and the far west moved the least.
states.summary: Barr won by 12.1 points, 18.5 closer than Trump's 2024 margin; all 120 counties moved left, and Franklin County flipped.

states.name: Tennessee
states.title: Hagerty holds Tennessee as Murfreesboro, Clarksville and Chattanooga swing away
states.dek: Bill Hagerty won a second Senate term by 12 points, but all 95 counties moved toward the Democrats from 2024, and three metro counties (Rutherford, Montgomery and Hamilton) narrowly went for Marquita Bradshaw.
states.summary: Hagerty won by 12.2 points, but all 95 counties moved left; Rutherford, Montgomery and Hamilton flipped to Bradshaw.

states.name: Iowa
states.title: Iowa's 99 counties all moved left as Turek took the Senate seat
states.dek: Josh Turek won by 4.1 points in a state Donald Trump carried by 13.3 two years ago. Every county shifted toward the Democrats, most in Crawford and Wapello counties and least in the state's far northwest corner.
states.summary: Turek flips Iowa's Senate seat by 4.1 points; all 99 counties moved left, ten flipped, and Pottawattamie went narrowly Democratic.

states.name: Virginia
states.title: All 133 Virginia localities moved toward Warner, from Manassas to the coalfields
states.dek: Mark Warner won a fourth Senate term by about 23 points, 17 more than Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. The biggest swings came in Prince William County and its two cities, and in Southwest Virginia, where turnout fell most.
states.summary: Warner won by 22.7 points; all 133 counties and cities moved left, 11 flipped from Trump, none the other way.

states.name: Oklahoma
states.title: Every Oklahoma county moved left, but Kevin Hern still won by 18
states.dek: All 77 counties shifted toward the Democrats from 2024. Oklahoma and Cleveland counties flipped. The biggest swings came in the Panhandle, the Oklahoma City suburbs and a band of southern and eastern counties.
states.summary: Hern won by 17.9 points, about half Trump's margin; all 77 counties moved left, and Oklahoma and Cleveland counties flipped.

states.name: Ohio
states.title: Brown retakes Ohio as all 88 counties move toward Democrats
states.dek: Sherrod Brown beat Jon Husted by 4.9 points in a state Donald Trump carried by 11. The biggest moves came in small, deep-red Appalachian counties where turnout fell the most. Eight Trump counties flipped.
states.summary: Brown wins by 4.9 points, a 16-point move from 2024; all 88 counties shift left, eight flip, Appalachian counties move most.

states.name: Wyoming
states.title: All 23 Wyoming counties moved toward Byrd; Hageman still won by 30
states.dek: Harriet Hageman won Wyoming's open Senate seat by 30.5 points, about 16 points less than Donald Trump's 2024 margin. Albany County, home to Laramie, flipped. Sweetwater, Natrona and Laramie counties moved the most.
states.summary: Hageman won Wyoming's Senate seat by 30.5 points, down from Trump's 46; all 23 counties moved left and Albany flipped.

states.name: Alaska
states.title: Alaska moves 15 points left as Peltola leads Sullivan, count unfinished
states.dek: Mary Peltola leads Sen. Dan Sullivan by 1.7 points with 84 percent of the vote counted, in a state Donald Trump carried by 13.8. A ranked-choice tally on Nov. 18 may decide the race.
states.summary: Peltola leads Sullivan by 1.7 points with 84% counted, a 15.5-point move left from 2024; AP has not called it.

states.name: Colorado
states.title: Every Colorado county moved left; El Paso and Douglas went Democratic
states.dek: John Hickenlooper won a second Senate term by 25 points, more than twice Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. The biggest moves came in Adams County, Weld County and the San Luis Valley. The smallest came in tiny, deeply Republican counties.
states.summary: Hickenlooper won by 25 points; all 64 counties moved left, and eight Trump counties, including El Paso and Douglas, flipped.

states.name: Nebraska
states.title: Every Nebraska county moved toward Osborn, but Ricketts held on
states.dek: All 93 counties voted to the left of their 2024 presidential result, Sarpy flipped, and the biggest moves came in packing-plant and Panhandle counties. But Dan Osborn's statewide deficit looks a lot like his 2024 loss.
states.summary: All 93 Nebraska counties moved toward independent Dan Osborn and Sarpy flipped, but Pete Ricketts won by 6.2 points.

states.name: Illinois
states.title: Chicago's suburbs swing hardest as Stratton wins Illinois by 24 points
states.dek: Juliana Stratton's Senate margin more than doubled Kamala Harris's 2024 showing. Cook County and the collar counties moved 14 to 18 points; much of rural downstate barely budged, and a few western counties moved toward Republicans.
states.summary: Stratton won by 24 points, 13 better than Harris, with Chicago and its suburbs moving most; McHenry and Sangamon flipped.

states.name: Idaho
states.title: Ada County flips as Idaho's Senate margin shrinks by 13 points
states.dek: Republican Jim Risch won a fourth term by 23 points over independent Todd Achilles. Still, 43 of Idaho's 44 counties moved left of their 2024 presidential vote, with the biggest moves in the east and the south-central counties.
states.summary: Risch won by 23 points, 13.5 points closer than Trump's 2024 margin; Ada County flipped, and only Latah moved right.

states.name: Delaware
states.title: Coons carries Sussex as Delaware moves 12 points toward Democrats
states.dek: Chris Coons won a fourth Senate term by 27 points. All three of Delaware's counties moved toward Democrats by similar amounts, and Republican Sussex County voted for him for the first time.
states.summary: Coons won by 27.1 points, a 12.4-point move from 2024, and Sussex County flipped from Trump to the Democrat.

states.name: California
states.title: Inland California swings to Becerra; ten Trump counties flip
states.dek: Xavier Becerra leads Steve Hilton by 31.5 points with 83 percent of the expected vote counted, a margin 11 points wider than Kamala Harris's. The biggest moves came in Imperial County, the Central Valley and the Inland Empire.
states.summary: Becerra leads by 31.5 points in a partial count; ten Trump counties flip, led by Imperial, Kern and San Bernardino.

states.name: New Hampshire
states.title: New Hampshire moved left everywhere, but kept its Republican governor
states.dek: All ten counties moved toward Democrat Chris Pappas, who won the open Senate seat by nearly 14 points and flipped Rockingham, Carroll and Sullivan counties. On the same ballots, Gov. Kelly Ayotte won a second term by about four.
states.summary: Every county moved left as Chris Pappas won the Senate seat by 13.7 points, while Republican Kelly Ayotte held the governorship.

states.name: Nevada
states.title: Clark County's 13-point swing puts Aaron Ford in Nevada's governor's office
states.dek: Democrat Aaron Ford unseated Gov. Joe Lombardo in a state Donald Trump carried two years ago. Fifteen of Nevada's 17 counties moved left, but most of the swing came from Las Vegas, and no county changed sides.
states.summary: Aaron Ford beats Gov. Joe Lombardo by 7.7 points as Clark County moves 13 points left and Douglas County moves right.

states.name: Florida
states.title: Miami-Dade and Osceola led Florida's swing; The Villages went the other way
states.dek: Ashley Moody held Florida's Senate seat by 2.9 points in a state Donald Trump carried by 13.1. Sixty-six of 67 counties moved toward Angie Nixon, and seven Trump counties flipped, from Jacksonville to Kissimmee.
states.summary: Moody won by 2.9 points after a 10-point swing; Miami-Dade, Osceola and five other Trump counties flipped, while Sumter moved right.

states.name: Montana
states.title: Helena and Livingston flip as Montana shifts left, but Alme wins
states.dek: Independent Seth Bodnar ran 9 points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024 and carried two counties Trump had won. Republican Kurt Alme still won by about 11 points while Bodnar and the Democratic nominee split the opposition.
states.summary: Montana moved 9 points left in its Senate race, but Republican Kurt Alme won by 10.6 against a divided opposition.

states.name: Wisconsin
states.title: Crowley wins Wisconsin by 8 as Brown, Kenosha and Racine flip
states.dek: David Crowley's win for governor moved 71 of Wisconsin's 72 counties toward Democrats compared with 2024. Milwaukee and the mid-sized cities led the shift, while Tom Tiffany's Northwoods home barely moved.
states.summary: Crowley won by 8 points, an 8.9-point move from Trump's 2024 edge; seven counties flipped and none went Republican.

states.name: Michigan
states.title: In Michigan, all 83 counties moved left; Wayne and Macomb led
states.dek: Abdul El-Sayed won the open Senate seat by 7.1 points in a state Donald Trump carried by 1.4. The largest moves came in metro Detroit, where Wayne and Macomb counties swung 12 to 14 points.
states.summary: Michigan: El-Sayed wins by 7.1 as all 83 counties move left, led by Wayne and Macomb in metro Detroit.

states.name: South Dakota
states.title: Black Hills tilt toward independent Bengs as Rounds holds South Dakota
states.dek: Sen. Mike Rounds won a third term by 21 points, eight fewer than Donald Trump's 2024 margin. The shift was sharpest around Rapid City and Sioux Falls, while reservation counties and the Pierre area moved the other way.
states.summary: Rounds beat independent Brian Bengs by 21 points, an 8-point shift from 2024, led by the Black Hills and Sioux Falls.

states.name: New York
states.title: The city swung back to Hochul; the north country kept drifting right
states.dek: Kathy Hochul won by 19.6 points, seven better than Kamala Harris, on big leftward moves in the Bronx, Queens and the suburbs. Half of New York's counties moved the other way, nearly a third of all right-moving counties nationwide.
states.summary: Hochul won by 19.6 points on surging city and suburban margins, while 31 counties, mostly upstate, moved toward Republicans.

states.name: Massachusetts
states.title: Every Massachusetts county moved toward Markey, Bristol most of all
states.dek: Edward Markey won a third full term by a wider margin than Kamala Harris had in 2024. The biggest moves came in the closest counties, especially on the South Coast, and in places where fewer 2024 voters returned.
states.summary: Markey widened the Democratic margin in all 14 counties, by 11 points in Bristol and by just one on Cape Cod.

states.name: Minnesota
states.title: In Minnesota, the regional cities moved most as Flanagan won by 10
states.dek: Peggy Flanagan beat Michele Tafoya by 10.1 points, about six points better than Kamala Harris did. The biggest swings came in counties around Duluth, Rochester, Moorhead, Austin and Worthington. The deep-red countryside moved far less, and one suburb moved the other way.
states.summary: Flanagan won by 10.1; regional-city counties like Clay, Mower and Nobles swung hardest, while Carver County moved toward Republicans.

states.name: Oregon
states.title: Every Oregon county moved toward Merkley, while Kotek ran 10 points behind him
states.dek: Jeff Merkley beat Kamala Harris's 2024 margin by five points and carried Marion, Tillamook and Wasco, three counties Donald Trump won. On the same ballots, Gov. Tina Kotek won by less than Harris did.
states.summary: All 36 counties shifted left for Merkley, a modest five-point move, while Kotek trailed Harris's margin in a closer governor's race.

states.name: Connecticut
states.title: Connecticut moves 4.6 points left as Lamont wins a third term
states.dek: Ned Lamont beat Ryan Fazio by 19.1 points, 4.6 points wider than Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. That is a real move, but well short of the 14-point move typical of counties nationally.
states.summary: Ned Lamont won a third term by 19.1 points, a 4.6-point move left of 2024, well below the national typical move.

states.name: Maryland
states.title: Washington suburbs swing harder to Moore; the Eastern Shore moves the other way
states.dek: Wes Moore beat Dan Cox again, and by more than Kamala Harris won Maryland. Most of the extra margin came from the big Washington suburbs and Frederick. A few small Eastern Shore counties moved toward Cox.
states.summary: Moore gained about 4 points on Harris, mostly in Montgomery, Prince George's and Frederick, while small Eastern Shore counties moved toward Cox.

states.name: Maine
states.title: Jackson beat Collins, yet Maine's Senate map came out redder than 2024
states.dek: Troy Jackson unseated Susan Collins by 6.3 points. Even so, 14 of Maine's 16 counties voted more Republican for Senate than they did for president in 2024. That shows how far Collins ran ahead of her party, not that Republicans gained ground.
states.summary: Jackson won by 6.3 points, but Collins ran ahead of Trump, and 14 of 16 counties moved slightly right.

states.name: Vermont
states.title: Vermont's counties all swung right, and the reason was Phil Scott
states.dek: All 14 counties moved toward the Republican column between Kamala Harris's 2024 win and Gov. Phil Scott's sixth-term victory. On the same ballot, voters restored Democratic supermajorities in the Legislature, so the shift tracks one governor more than a party.
states.summary: All 14 counties moved right as Phil Scott won a sixth term by 6.6 points while Democrats gained at the Statehouse.

counties.title: Los Angeles County gives Becerra a 46-point margin, up 13 from 2024
counties.dek: The nation's biggest county moved 13 points toward the Democrats in the race for California governor, slightly more than the state did, with about four-fifths as many votes cast as in 2024.
counties.summary: California's Los Angeles County went from D+32.9 for Harris to D+46.4 for Xavier Becerra, a 13-point move left.

counties.title: In Maricopa County, Hobbs turns a Trump edge into a 16-point win
counties.dek: Arizona's biggest county, which Donald Trump carried by 3.5 points in 2024, gave Gov. Katie Hobbs a 16-point margin over Andy Biggs. That is a 20-point move, on an electorate about three-quarters the size of 2024's.
counties.summary: Maricopa swung 20 points left, from Trump by 3.5 to Hobbs by 16.2, supplying about three-quarters of her statewide lead.

counties.title: Cook County gives Stratton a 60-point margin, 18 points past Harris
counties.dek: Chicago and its suburbs backed Juliana Stratton over Don Tracy by 60 points with 93 percent of the vote counted. That was the second-largest move left among Illinois's 102 counties, on turnout at 71 percent of 2024.
counties.summary: Cook County moved 18 points left from 2024, giving Stratton a 60-point margin on turnout at 71 percent of the presidential year.

counties.title: Harris County swings 27 points toward Talarico, outpacing Texas' other big counties
counties.dek: Texas' most populous county gave James Talarico a 33-point win over Ken Paxton, up from Kamala Harris's 5.5-point edge in 2024. It did so on fewer votes than two years ago, so it is unclear how much came from turnout and how much from changed minds.
counties.summary: Harris County, Texas, moved 27 points left, from D+5.5 to D+33.0, as James Talarico beat Ken Paxton statewide.

counties.title: Orange County moves toward Becerra, but only about half as far as California
counties.dek: Xavier Becerra carried Orange County by about 9 points, a 6-point move left from Kamala Harris's narrow 2024 win there. That was a little over half of California's shift, and far smaller than the swings next door in Riverside and San Bernardino.
counties.summary: Orange County moved 6 points toward Democrats, D+2.6 to D+9.1, a little over half California's statewide shift for governor.

counties.title: San Diego County moves left but trails California's swing toward Becerra
counties.dek: Xavier Becerra carried San Diego County by about 24 points, up from Kamala Harris's 17. The county's last Republican House seat also fell. Even so, the county moved less than California did and less than most of the country's biggest counties.
counties.summary: San Diego County moved 8 points toward Democrats, from D+16.8 to D+24.4, short of California's 11.4-point move.

counties.title: Miami-Dade backs Nixon by 7 as Moody holds Florida's Senate seat
counties.dek: Florida's biggest county by votes cast moved 19 points toward Democrats from 2024, the fourth-largest swing in the state. Black and white neighborhoods led it; Hispanic precincts still leaned Republican, by less, on a high midterm turnout.
counties.summary: Miami-Dade went from R+11 for Trump to D+7 for Angie Nixon, a 19-point move, while Ashley Moody held Florida.

counties.title: Dallas County nearly doubles its Democratic lead as Talarico beats Paxton
counties.dek: Dallas County was already Democratic territory. Fewer people voted than in 2024, but James Talarico's lead in votes was close to double Kamala Harris's, and the county supplied nearly 30 percent of his statewide margin.
counties.summary: Dallas County moved 23 points left, from D+22.2 to D+45.6, on 92 percent of its 2024 turnout.

counties.title: Clark County, home of Las Vegas, delivers Nevada's governorship to Aaron Ford
counties.dek: Las Vegas and its suburbs went from a 2.6-point Harris edge to a 15.5-point win for Ford over Gov. Joe Lombardo, the county's former sheriff. It was the largest move of any Nevada county, and it came from a smaller midterm electorate.
counties.summary: Nevada's Clark County moved 13 points toward Democrats, from D+2.6 to D+15.5, and Ford's lead there exceeded his statewide margin.

counties.title: In Wayne County, Detroit and Dearborn give El-Sayed Michigan's biggest swing
counties.dek: Abdul El-Sayed carried Michigan's largest county by 43 points. That is 14 points better than Kamala Harris's 2024 margin and the biggest leftward move of any Michigan county, with turnout about 14 percent below the presidential year.
counties.summary: Wayne County, Michigan: El-Sayed won by 43 points, a 14-point move left, the state's largest, on 86% of 2024 turnout.

counties.title: Tarrant County, long Texas Republicans' urban anchor, swings 24 points to Talarico
counties.dek: Trump carried Fort Worth's county by five points in 2024. Two years later James Talarico won it by 19 with fewer voters, and Democrats took the county judge's seat for the first time since 1986.
counties.summary: Tarrant County, Texas, went from Trump by 5 to Talarico by 19, a 24-point move on 89% of 2024's turnout.

counties.title: Oakland County Gave El-Sayed a Wider Win but Moved Less Than Michigan
counties.dek: Michigan's second-biggest county voted Democratic by a larger margin than in 2024. But it shifted only half as much as the state, and local reporting traced much of the gap to a few heavily Jewish suburbs.
counties.summary: Oakland County moved about 4 points toward Democrats, one of Michigan's smallest shifts in a year when every county moved left.

counties.title: Hennepin gave Flanagan her Senate cushion but moved less than neighbors
counties.dek: The Minneapolis county gave Peggy Flanagan a 46-point margin, and her lead there in raw votes was larger than her lead statewide. Its shift since 2024 was smaller than Ramsey's, Anoka's and Minnesota's as a whole.
counties.summary: Hennepin went D+45.9 for Flanagan, 3 points left of 2024, a smaller move than Minnesota's 5.9 points.

counties.title: Broward gives Nixon a much wider margin on far fewer votes
counties.dek: Florida's most Democratic large county moved 15 points toward Angie Nixon from 2024, the state's fifth-largest swing, though about a quarter fewer people voted. It was not enough to overcome Ashley Moody's lead elsewhere.
counties.summary: Broward moved 15 points left to D+32, fifth-biggest shift in Florida, as turnout fell to 76% of 2024's.

counties.title: In San Antonio's Bexar County, a 10-point Democratic edge becomes 35
counties.dek: San Antonio's home county gave James Talarico a 35.5-point win over Ken Paxton. That is a 26-point move from 2024 that tracked the statewide swing almost exactly, on about 99,000 fewer votes than two years ago.
counties.summary: Bexar County moved 26 points left, from D+9.8 to D+35.5, matching Texas's statewide swing as Talarico won.

counties.title: Brooklyn gives Hochul a 59-point margin, 15 points past Harris
counties.dek: Kings County moved 15 points toward the Democrats from the 2024 presidential race, more than twice New York's statewide shift, as Orthodox leaders backed Kathy Hochul and Democrats won back southern Brooklyn seats they had lost.
counties.summary: Brooklyn moved 15 points left from 2024, giving Kathy Hochul a 59-point margin on turnout at 74% of the presidential year.

counties.title: Riverside County, a Trump county in 2024, swings 17 points to Becerra
counties.dek: Two years after Donald Trump narrowly carried it, the Inland Empire county gave Xavier Becerra a 15-point lead with just over half the expected vote counted. That is one of the larger moves among California's big counties.
counties.summary: Riverside County went from R+1.3 for Trump to D+15.5 for Becerra, a 17-point move with about half the vote counted.

counties.title: In Middlesex, Markey's home county, a modest move left on lower turnout
counties.dek: Edward Markey won Massachusetts' biggest county by 44 points, about five points better than Kamala Harris did there. About a quarter fewer ballots were cast, so the count alone can't show how much of that shift was persuasion.
counties.summary: Middlesex County, Massachusetts' largest, moved about five points toward Democrats as Edward Markey won it by 44 points on lower turnout.

counties.title: San Bernardino County swings 21 points to Becerra after backing Trump
counties.dek: The Inland Empire county that narrowly favored Donald Trump in 2024 gave Xavier Becerra an 18.7-point margin for governor, the third-largest move in California, on a count about a fifth smaller than two years ago.
counties.summary: San Bernardino County, Trump by 2.1 points in 2024, backed Becerra by 18.7, a 21-point move left on smaller turnout.

counties.title: Silicon Valley's Santa Clara County moves only slightly left as California swings to Becerra
counties.dek: The home county of San Jose stayed one of California's most Democratic. But its 2.5-point move toward Xavier Becerra was among the smallest in the state, in an election where most of California moved more than four times as far.
counties.summary: Santa Clara County gave Becerra a 42.5-point margin, only 2.5 points better than Harris did, while the state swung 11.4.

counties.title: Trump's home county gives Nixon a 10-point win as Moody holds Florida
counties.dek: Palm Beach County moved nearly 10 points toward Democrats from 2024, a little less than Florida as a whole. Local reporting points mainly to turnout: registered Democrats voted at far higher rates than Republicans.
counties.summary: Palm Beach County, Trump's home, went for Angie Nixon by 10 points, a move of nearly 10 toward Democrats.

counties.title: Alameda County's Becerra vote outruns Harris but trails California's swing
counties.dek: Xavier Becerra won the East Bay county by 61 points with about 70 percent of the vote counted, 8 points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024. That gain was smaller than California's statewide move and came on far fewer ballots.
counties.summary: Alameda County moved 8 points toward Democrats, to D+61.3, less than California's 10-point swing, with 63% of 2024's turnout counted.

counties.title: Austin's Travis County, Talarico's home base, moves 19 points left
counties.dek: James Talarico won Texas's most Democratic big county by 58.5 points, up from Kamala Harris's 39.3. Harris and Bexar counties moved further, but no blue county of similar size outside Texas moved as far.
counties.summary: Travis County, home to Austin, went D+58.5 for Talarico, a 19-point move left on 95% of its 2024 vote.

counties.title: Suffolk County, a 10-point Trump win in 2024, tips to Hochul
counties.dek: Gov. Kathy Hochul narrowly carried Long Island's biggest county against Bruce Blakeman. It moved about 11 points toward the Democrats, less than the typical county nationally. Republicans still won key races further down the ballot.
counties.summary: Suffolk County, Long Island, moved about 11 points left and narrowly backed Hochul after giving Trump a 10-point win.

counties.title: In Blakeman's own Nassau County, Hochul edges ahead by about 1,200 votes
counties.dek: Trump carried Nassau by 4 points in 2024. Two years later, with a quarter fewer ballots cast, the county executive running for governor trailed Kathy Hochul at home by a fraction of a point, a smaller shift than the state's.
counties.summary: Bruce Blakeman's home county, Nassau, moved 4 points left and narrowly favored Kathy Hochul, D+0.2, with counting unfinished.

counties.title: Wake County nearly doubles the Democratic margin as Cooper wins Senate seat
counties.dek: North Carolina's largest county gave Roy Cooper a 47-point win, up from Kamala Harris's 26. That one county supplied about three in 10 of his statewide margin, and the last Republican legislators from Wake lost their seats.
counties.summary: North Carolina: Cooper won by 19.6 points; all 100 counties moved left, and Wake County supplied his largest margin.

counties.title: In Allegheny County, Shapiro doubles Harris's margin as turnout falls
counties.dek: Pennsylvania's governor won the Pittsburgh-area county by nearly 44 points on about seven-tenths of the 2024 vote. Its 23-point swing toward Democrats almost exactly matched the statewide swing, and local mapping found the biggest gains in the suburbs.
counties.summary: Allegheny County moved 23 points toward Democrats as Josh Shapiro won it by 44, nearly matching the statewide swing.

counties.title: In Ashley Moody's home county, Hillsborough swings to Angie Nixon by nine points
counties.dek: Hillsborough County, home to Tampa, went from a narrow Trump win in 2024 to a 9-point win for Angie Nixon in the Senate race. Even so, Senator Ashley Moody, who grew up there, held the seat statewide.
counties.summary: Hillsborough flipped from R+3.1 to D+9.0 for Nixon, a 12-point move, though Moody won statewide.

counties.title: Franklin County's margin nearly matches Sherrod Brown's whole Ohio lead
counties.dek: Columbus and its suburbs voted D+42 for Brown over Jon Husted. That was 14 points to the left of their 2024 presidential vote, on 15 percent fewer ballots so far. The move was smaller than Ohio's typical county but worth about 213,000 votes.
counties.summary: Franklin County moved 14 points left to D+42. Its lead of about 213,000 votes nearly equaled Brown's statewide margin.

counties.title: Sacramento County moves 10 points toward Democrats, tracking California almost exactly
counties.dek: The capital's home county gave Xavier Becerra a wider margin than it gave Kamala Harris. That shift is close to California's own. With about four in ten expected ballots still uncounted, the electorate so far is much smaller than in 2024.
counties.summary: Sacramento County went from D+19.7 to D+29.5, a 10-point move nearly identical to California's 10.3.

counties.title: Queens swings 20 points toward Democrats as Hochul wins back the borough
counties.dek: Two years after Kamala Harris carried Queens by less than 25 points, Gov. Kathy Hochul won it by 44. The move was the second-largest of any county in New York. Flushing and the Rockaways show where Republicans held on.
counties.summary: Queens moved 20 points toward Democrats, the second-largest move in New York, as Hochul won it by 44 points.

counties.title: Philadelphia gives Shapiro a 79-point margin, on far fewer votes than 2024
counties.dek: The city moved 20 points toward the Democrat from the 2024 presidential race. That was less than most of Pennsylvania moved, and about 231,000 fewer people voted, so the bigger margin is part turnout and part voters switching sides.
counties.summary: Philadelphia went from D+59 to D+79 for Shapiro, a 20-point move, on 68 percent of its 2024 turnout.

counties.title: Manhattan stood still for Hochul while Brooklyn and Queens swung left
counties.dek: Kathy Hochul won New York County by almost exactly Kamala Harris's 2024 margin, while the state moved seven points toward Democrats. A neighborhood analysis finds she lost ground in the wealthy areas that a new pied-à-terre tax hits hardest.
counties.summary: Manhattan barely moved, Hochul D+64.6 against Harris's D+64.8, while Brooklyn and Queens swung sharply toward Democrats.

counties.title: Fairfax County, home to 80,000 federal workers, swings 17 points toward Warner
counties.dek: Virginia's biggest county gave Mark Warner a 52-point win, 17 points better than Kamala Harris's 2024 margin there. It voted on 80 percent of the 2024 turnout, after a year of federal layoffs.
counties.summary: Fairfax County moved 17 points left, from D+35.0 to D+52.0, as Warner won a fourth Senate term.

counties.title: Cuyahoga County gave Brown a bigger lead on far fewer votes
counties.dek: Ohio's second-biggest county moved 12 points toward Democrats between Kamala Harris's 2024 race and Sherrod Brown's Senate win. That was one of the smaller shifts in a state where all 88 counties moved left, and Cuyahoga started from a deep-blue base.
counties.summary: Cuyahoga moved 12 points left, to D+43.7, a smaller shift than most of Ohio, as Brown's lead grew on fewer votes.

counties.title: Orange County widens its Democratic lead as Florida stays narrowly red
counties.dek: Angie Nixon carried Orlando's home county by more than 28 points, more than double Kamala Harris's 2024 margin, with fewer people voting. It was among Florida's biggest swings and still not enough to beat Ashley Moody statewide.
counties.summary: Orange County, home to Orlando, moved 15 points toward Democrats, giving Angie Nixon a 28.5-point win as she lost statewide.

counties.title: In Fulton County, Ossoff widens Atlanta's Democratic lead on fewer ballots
counties.dek: Georgia's biggest county moved 14 points toward the Democrats between 2024 and 2026. That was close to the typical county in the state, while the suburbs around it moved further. North Fulton's Republican seats fell further down the ballot.
counties.summary: Fulton County, Georgia, moved from D+44.9 to D+59.3 as Jon Ossoff won reelection, on 85 percent of 2024's turnout.

counties.title: Collin County, Paxton's political home, swings 23 points toward Talarico
counties.dek: The fast-growing suburbs north of Dallas where Ken Paxton started his career went from an 11-point Trump county in 2024 to a 12-point James Talarico win. That matched the statewide margin exactly.
counties.summary: Collin County, Texas: Paxton's home county moved 23 points left, from R+11 to D+12, landing exactly on Talarico's statewide margin.

counties.title: Charlotte's Mecklenburg County moves 21 points toward Cooper, about North Carolina's pace
counties.dek: Roy Cooper carried the Charlotte-based county by 54 points, 21 more than Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. Fewer people voted than in 2024, but Cooper's raw-vote lead grew, and local reporting points to Republican drop-off alongside a Democratic turnout push.
counties.summary: Mecklenburg County, N.C., moved 21 points toward Democrat Roy Cooper, near the state's 23-point shift, on 77% of 2024's turnout.

counties.title: In Contra Costa, Becerra widens Democrats' edge, but less than California does
counties.dek: Xavier Becerra carried the East Bay county by 42.5 points with four-fifths of the expected vote counted. That is about 5 points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024, and less than half of California's statewide shift.
counties.summary: Contra Costa moved about 5 points toward Democrats for governor, under half California's shift, with a fifth of its vote uncounted.

counties.title: Macomb County stays Republican for Mike Rogers, but by under two points
counties.dek: Michigan's big blue-collar suburb north of Detroit went from a 13.7-point Trump county in 2024 to a 1.8-point Rogers win, the second-largest swing toward Democrats among Michigan's 83 counties.
counties.summary: Macomb moved 12 points toward Democrats, the second-largest swing in Michigan, but still narrowly backed Republican Mike Rogers.

counties.title: Pima County doubles its Democratic margin as Arizona swings harder still
counties.dek: Katie Hobbs carried Pima County, home to Tucson, by 31 points, double Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. But the county's 16-point move trailed Arizona's 19-point swing, and Pima cast about a fifth fewer votes than in 2024.
counties.summary: Pima County, Arizona: Hobbs won by 31 points, a 16-point move left from 2024, smaller than the state's 19-point swing.

counties.title: In Pinellas, a narrow Nixon edge and a smaller swing than Florida's
counties.dek: Pinellas County backed Donald Trump in 2024. This year it gave Democrat Angie Nixon a lead of about 2,600 votes over Sen. Ashley Moody. Its six-point move left was real but smaller than the state's, and fewer people voted.
counties.summary: Pinellas went narrowly to Angie Nixon, D+0.7, a 6-point move left, smaller than Florida's 10-point statewide shift.

counties.title: Denton County backs Talarico by 8 points; its Republican county judge survives
counties.dek: The fast-growing North Texas suburb went from a 13-point Trump county to an 8-point Talarico county. That 22-point move was smaller than in most of Texas's other big counties, and voters kept most local Republicans in office.
counties.summary: Denton County, Texas, moved 22 points left to back James Talarico by 8.4, though local Republicans largely held on.

counties.title: Montgomery County doubles its Democratic margin for hometown Gov. Josh Shapiro
counties.dek: Josh Shapiro's home county gave him a 46-point win over Stacy Garrity, twice Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. Turnout fell to 75 percent of 2024's, and a county election official says Republicans staying home likely did much of the work.
counties.summary: Montgomery County, Pa., moved 23 points left as Shapiro won his home county by 46 on lower turnout.

counties.title: Multnomah County gave Merkley two-thirds of his Oregon margin
counties.dek: Portland's home county moved about five points toward the Democrats from 2024. That matched Oregon as a whole and fell well short of the swings in most other big Democratic counties. Voters also chose a new county chair.
counties.summary: Multnomah moved 5 points left, matching Oregon, and supplied about two-thirds of Jeff Merkley's statewide margin.

counties.title: In Angie Nixon's Jacksonville, Duval swings 12 points toward Democrats
counties.dek: Duval County, which Donald Trump carried narrowly in 2024, gave its hometown Senate candidate an 11-point win. Its 12-point move outpaced Florida's, on an electorate a quarter smaller than two years ago.
counties.summary: Duval County swung from R+1.5 to D+10.8 for hometown Democrat Angie Nixon, a 12-point move, though she lost statewide.

counties.title: Milwaukee County Makes Wisconsin's Biggest Move Toward Its Own County Executive
counties.dek: David Crowley carried his home county by 52 points on his way to the governor's office. That was the largest shift toward Democrats in any of Wisconsin's 72 counties, even though nearly a quarter fewer people voted than in 2024.
counties.summary: Wisconsin: Milwaukee County moved 14 points left, the state's biggest shift, as its county executive, David Crowley, won the governorship.

counties.title: Hochul's home county barely moved while New York swung left
counties.dek: Kathy Hochul carried Erie County by a little more than Kamala Harris did in 2024. Early voting rose sharply, but the county's 1-point move toward Democrats was far smaller than the state's 7 points.
counties.summary: Erie County moved 1 point toward Democrats, from D+9.7 to D+11.1, while New York moved 7.

counties.title: Gwinnett swings 26 points to Ossoff, outpacing Atlanta's other big suburbs
counties.dek: Georgia's second-biggest county gave Jon Ossoff a 43-point margin over Mike Collins, up from Kamala Harris's 16.5 in 2024. Fewer people voted, and Democrats took every seat on the county commission.
counties.summary: Gwinnett moved 26 points left, fourth-most in Georgia, as Ossoff won it by 43 on lighter turnout.

counties.title: Westchester moved toward Hochul, but less than New York did
counties.dek: Kathy Hochul carried the county by nearly 32 points, about five more than Kamala Harris did in 2024. A countywide scanner failure on Election Day left about a tenth of the expected vote still uncounted days later.
counties.summary: Westchester moved 5 points toward the Democrats, less than New York's 7, and its count is still unfinished.

counties.title: Hamilton County gave Brown a bigger win, but moved less than Ohio
counties.dek: Cincinnati's county voted for Sherrod Brown by 25 points, up from Kamala Harris's 15-point edge in 2024. Every Ohio county moved left; Hamilton moved less than all but two, on a midterm turnout about 84% of 2024's.
counties.summary: Ohio: Hamilton County backed Sherrod Brown by 25 points, a 10-point move left, smaller than nearly every other Ohio county's.

counties.title: Montgomery County makes Maryland's biggest move toward Democrats in governor's race
counties.dek: In Maryland's largest county, Wes Moore beat Dan Cox by about 63 points. That is nearly 10 points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024 and the biggest move in the state, with about a fifth of the expected vote still uncounted.
counties.summary: Montgomery County, Md., moved nearly 10 points left of 2024, Maryland's largest shift, as Wes Moore won it by 63 points.

counties.title: San Francisco moves left again, but less than the state around it
counties.dek: Xavier Becerra carried the City and County of San Francisco by 69 points, four more than Kamala Harris's 2024 margin. That shift was less than half of California's, and so far far fewer ballots have been counted than in 2024.
counties.summary: San Francisco gave Becerra a 69-point margin, up 4 from 2024, a smaller move than California's 10-point statewide shift.

counties.title: In DuPage, Illinois' old Republican suburb, a 16-point swing left
counties.dek: Juliana Stratton carried Chicago's western suburbs by nearly 29 points, more than double Kamala Harris's 2024 margin, on a quarter fewer ballots. Democrats took every county office on the ballot, ousting Republicans who had held seats for decades.
counties.summary: DuPage County moved 16 points left, from D+13 to D+29, as Democrats swept county offices in Chicago's western suburbs.

counties.title: In Cobb, Ossoff doubles Democrats' lead as the last GOP footholds fall
counties.dek: Jon Ossoff won Cobb County by 34 points. Kamala Harris had won it by 15. Fewer people voted than in 2024, and Democrats also took the school board and a long-held East Cobb commission seat.
counties.summary: Cobb moved 19 points left as Ossoff won it by 34 and Democrats flipped its school board.

counties.title: Fort Bend, Texas' most diverse county, swings 27 points to Talarico
counties.dek: A county Kamala Harris carried by under two points in 2024 gave James Talarico a 29-point win over Ken Paxton, beating his statewide margin as Democrats also took the county judge's seat.
counties.summary: Fort Bend County moved 27 points left, from Harris D+1.6 to Talarico D+28.6, on 92% of 2024 turnout.

counties.title: In Grand Rapids' Kent County, El-Sayed widens Democrats' West Michigan edge
counties.dek: Abdul El-Sayed carried Kent County by nearly 14 points, more than double Kamala Harris's 2024 margin, as a smaller midterm electorate in Gerald Ford's old Republican base kept moving toward Democrats.
counties.summary: Kent County, Michigan, moved 8 points toward Democrats, giving Abdul El-Sayed a 14-point win around Grand Rapids.

counties.title: DeKalb gave Ossoff more votes on a smaller turnout than 2024
counties.dek: Georgia's most Democratic big county moved 13 points left. That is small next to the state's 20-point move, but DeKalb started at D+65, and its vote margin still made up about a third of Jon Ossoff's statewide lead.
counties.summary: DeKalb went from D+64.8 to D+77.5 for Ossoff on 88 percent of its 2024 turnout, a smaller move than Georgia's.

counties.title: El Paso County, long Colorado's Republican anchor, votes for Hickenlooper
counties.dek: Donald Trump carried the Colorado Springs county by nearly 10 points in 2024. Two years later, John Hickenlooper won it by about 4. Fewer people voted, and the county elected a Democrat to Congress for the first time.
counties.summary: Colorado's biggest county went from Trump by 10 to Hickenlooper by 4, with turnout at 82% of 2024's.

counties.title: Bergen, New Jersey's biggest county, swings 21 points toward Cory Booker
counties.dek: Two years after Kamala Harris carried Bergen County by 3.4 points, Cory Booker won it by 24.6 with fewer voters turning out. The county's move almost exactly matched New Jersey's swing toward Democrats.
counties.summary: Bergen County moved 21 points left, from D+3.4 for Harris to D+24.6 for Booker, in step with the state.

counties.title: Worcester County shifts six points left, about the same as Massachusetts
counties.dek: Ed Markey won Massachusetts' second-biggest county by 16 points. Kamala Harris had won it by 10. About a quarter fewer people voted than in 2024, and a Republican from a Worcester County town couldn't get out from under President Trump.
counties.summary: Worcester County moved 6 points toward Democrats, from D+10 to D+16, close to Massachusetts' statewide shift.

counties.title: Dane County hands Crowley 80 percent, most of his statewide margin
counties.dek: Madison's county cast about 54,000 fewer votes than in 2024 yet gave David Crowley a raw margin slightly bigger than Kamala Harris's, a 9-point move left that tracked the state's swing almost exactly.
counties.summary: Dane County moved 9 points left to D+61, its 190,000-vote margin supplying most of Crowley's statewide win.

counties.title: Jeffco moves toward Hickenlooper, but less than most big Colorado counties
counties.dek: Jefferson County, west of Denver, gave John Hickenlooper a 32-point margin, 13 points more than Kamala Harris won it by. It still moved less than Colorado as a whole, and its voters appear to have narrowly rejected new school taxes.
counties.summary: Jefferson County moved 13 points toward Democrats in the Senate race, slightly less than Colorado's 14-point shift.

counties.title: Denver gives former mayor Hickenlooper 83%, moving 14 points left
counties.dek: Colorado's capital moved toward Democrats about as far as the state did, and it did so with far fewer voters than in 2024. Over the summer, its Democratic primary voters had turned against party veterans.
counties.summary: Denver backed John Hickenlooper by 70 points, a 14-point move left from 2024 that matched Colorado's statewide shift.

counties.title: Lee County, Florida, stays deep red, but Moody's margin shrinks by seven
counties.dek: Ashley Moody carried Southwest Florida's biggest county by 21 points. That was 7 points less than Donald Trump's 2024 margin there, and fewer voters turned out. Lee moved left about as much as a typical Florida county, but well short of the state's big metros.
counties.summary: Lee County backed Moody by 21.4 points, down from Trump's 28.4, as about 88,500 fewer people voted than in 2024.

counties.title: Bucks County, split evenly in 2024, gives Shapiro a 26-point win
counties.dek: Pennsylvania's most evenly divided big county moved nearly 26 points toward the Democrats in the governor's race. That was more than the state or its suburban neighbors moved. Turnout fell to three-quarters of 2024's, and Republicans lost their congressman.
counties.summary: Bucks County went from a 0.1-point Trump edge in 2024 to a 25.7-point Shapiro win, a 26-point move left.

counties.title: Essex County swings nearly nine points to Markey as turnout falls
counties.dek: Massachusetts' third-biggest county, home to Lawrence, Lynn and Salem, gave Sen. Edward Markey a 29-point win over John Deaton. Kamala Harris won it by 20 points in 2024. This year's count was a quarter smaller.
counties.summary: Essex County moved nearly 9 points toward Democrats, third-most in Massachusetts, as Markey won it by 29 on lower turnout.

counties.title: In Hamilton's home county, Kansas suburbs supplied the Senate-winning margin
counties.dek: Johnson County moved about 20 points toward the Democrats from 2024 and gave Adam Hamilton a 28-point win at home. In votes, that margin was bigger than his whole statewide lead, even though fewer people voted than in 2024.
counties.summary: Kansas: Johnson County swung 20 points left, and Hamilton's 83,000-vote margin there exceeded his statewide lead.

counties.title: Norfolk County moved toward Markey, but less than almost anywhere in Massachusetts
counties.dek: Edward Markey carried the suburbs south and west of Boston by 31 points, up from Kamala Harris's 29. Only one Massachusetts county moved less, and nearly a quarter fewer voters turned out, so his raw-vote margin was smaller than hers.
counties.summary: Norfolk County, Mass.: Markey won by 31 points, 3 better than Harris, one of the state's smallest moves.

counties.title: Talarico's home county north of Austin swings 23 points toward Democrats
counties.dek: Donald Trump carried Williamson County by 2.5 points in 2024. Two years later, James Talarico, who started his political career in Round Rock, won it by 20 points, and Democrats took control of the county commissioners court.
counties.summary: Williamson County, Texas, went from Trump +2.5 to Talarico +20.3, a 23-point move, as Democrats also won the commissioners court.

counties.title: Baltimore County edges right as Maryland and the nation swing left
counties.dek: Wes Moore won Maryland's second-biggest county by votes cast comfortably. But he ran a point behind Kamala Harris's 2024 margin there, one of nine Maryland jurisdictions that did not move left. Many mail ballots are still uncounted.
counties.summary: Baltimore County, Md.: Moore won by 23.5 points, a point under Harris's 2024 margin, as the state moved 2.7 points left.

counties.title: Rochester's Monroe County edges toward Hochul as suburban turnout slips
counties.dek: Kathy Hochul won Monroe County by 23 points, four more than Kamala Harris did in 2024. The county moved only about half as far as New York did, and about a quarter fewer people voted.
counties.summary: Monroe County, New York, moved 4 points toward Democrats as Hochul won it by 23, less than the statewide shift.

counties.title: Prince George's gives Moore an even wider edge on a smaller turnout
counties.dek: Maryland's majority-Black suburb beside Washington went 82 points for Gov. Wes Moore, seven points past Kamala Harris's 2024 margin, while only about two-thirds as many ballots have been counted so far and federal job cuts hung over the county.
counties.summary: Prince George's moved 7 points toward Democrats, to D+82, on 64% of its 2024 turnout so far.

counties.title: Brevard County moves 7 points left, less than Florida as a whole
counties.dek: On a Space Coast swamped by record flooding the day before the election, Ashley Moody carried Brevard comfortably. The county moved left about as much as a typical Florida county, but well short of the state's big metros.
counties.summary: Brevard stayed solidly Republican, moving 7 points left as election-eve flooding hit and a state House seat headed to recount.

counties.title: Arapahoe County, Colorado, swings 16 points toward Hickenlooper on smaller turnout
counties.dek: The suburban county that casts most of Aurora's votes gave John Hickenlooper a 36-point margin. That is 16 points better for Democrats than Kamala Harris did in 2024, with about a fifth fewer votes counted so far.
counties.summary: Arapahoe County moved 16 points toward Democrats, from D+20 to D+36, on turnout at 80% of 2024.

counties.title: In Louisville, Booker nearly doubles the Democratic margin but Kentucky stays red
counties.dek: Jefferson County gave Charles Booker a 32-point margin on a quarter fewer votes than 2024, a swing in line with Kentucky's other counties. Its suburbs also ousted Republican state lawmakers, though Andy Barr still won the Senate seat.
counties.summary: Louisville's Jefferson County moved 15 points toward Democrat Charles Booker, close to the typical Kentucky swing, as Andy Barr won.

counties.title: In Montgomery County, Trump's biggest 2024 margin shrank by more than half
counties.dek: The county north of Houston that gave Donald Trump his largest raw-vote win in 2024 still voted for Ken Paxton. His margin was 22 points, down from Trump's 45.5, and about 57,000 votes, down from about 140,000.
counties.summary: Montgomery County, Texas, stayed Republican but moved 23 points left as Paxton's margin fell from Trump's R+45.5 to R+22.2.

counties.title: Polk County, Florida's I-4 Republican anchor, swings 14 points toward Democrats
counties.dek: Ashley Moody still carried Polk, but by 6.7 points, down from Donald Trump's 20.7-point win in 2024. A schoolteacher also became the first Democrat in more than a decade to win a Polk seat in the Legislature.
counties.summary: Polk County moved 14 points left, from Trump by 20.7 to Moody by 6.7, on 74% of its 2024 vote.

counties.title: Ramsey County gives Peggy Flanagan her widest Minnesota margin
counties.dek: St. Paul's county went 8 points further toward Democrats than it did for Kamala Harris. Local reporting ties the shift to last winter's federal immigration crackdown, which also brought out an unusually large midterm vote.
counties.summary: Ramsey County moved 8 points left to D+51.5, about twice Hennepin's move, with 90% of 2024's turnout.

counties.title: Bernalillo County moved 17 points left, less than most of New Mexico
counties.dek: Sen. Ben Ray Luján won Albuquerque's home county by 38 points over a Republican who reached the ballot through a write-in campaign. But the state's biggest county was already strongly Democratic, and it ranked 23rd of 33 in how far it moved.
counties.summary: Bernalillo County went from D+21 to D+38 for Ben Ray Luján, a 17-point move, smaller than New Mexico's 20.5.

counties.title: Honolulu's Democratic margin doubles for Josh Green as turnout falls
counties.dek: Gov. Josh Green carried the City and County of Honolulu by 44 points, double Kamala Harris's 2024 margin, on 27 percent fewer ballots. Local analysts said many of Trump's 2024 voters stayed home, and Republicans lost Oahu House seats.
counties.summary: Hawaii: Green won by 45 points; Honolulu moved 22 points left, matching the state, on 73% of 2024's turnout.

counties.title: Memphis's Shelby County moves left, but less than the rest of Tennessee
counties.dek: Marquita Bradshaw won Shelby County by 37 points, 12 points better than Kamala Harris did. Smaller counties in Tennessee moved further, and Memphis voted with its congressional district newly split three ways.
counties.summary: Shelby County went from D+25.4 to D+37.2, a 12-point move that ranks 71st of Tennessee's 95 counties.

counties.title: Birmingham's county moves 21 points left, but Alabama stays red
counties.dek: Jefferson County gave Democrat Everett Wess a 31.6-point margin for Senate, triple Kamala Harris's edge in 2024, a 21-point move that ranked ninth among Alabama's 67 counties. Republican Barry Moore still won the seat statewide.
counties.summary: Alabama's biggest county moved 21 points toward Democrats for Senate, but Barry Moore won the state by 9.4 points.

counties.title: Chester County gives Shapiro a 36-point margin, ousts its last GOP legislators
counties.dek: Gov. Josh Shapiro won Philadelphia's western suburb by 36.5 points, 22 more than Kamala Harris did in 2024. That was slightly less than Pennsylvania's swing, and about a quarter fewer voters cast ballots.
counties.summary: Chester County went from D+14.5 for Harris to D+36.5 for Shapiro, a 22-point move on 75% of 2024's turnout.

counties.title: Central Jersey's Middlesex County moves 28 points left for Cory Booker
counties.dek: Two years after Kamala Harris carried it by 8 points, the county of Edison, New Brunswick and Perth Amboy gave Cory Booker a 36-point margin. That was one of New Jersey's largest moves, on two-thirds of 2024's vote.
counties.summary: Middlesex County, N.J., moved 28 points left, from Harris by 8 to Booker by 36, the third-largest move in the state.

counties.title: The Bronx swings 21 points back to Democrats, most in New York
counties.dek: Two years after the Bronx moved sharply toward Donald Trump, Kathy Hochul carried it by 67 points with fewer voters turning out, the largest move toward Democrats of any of New York's 62 counties.
counties.summary: Bronx County, New York: Hochul won by 67 points, a 21-point move from 2024 and the state's largest.

counties.title: Oregon's Washington County moves left, but less than the state
counties.dek: Sen. Jeff Merkley widened the Democratic margin in the Silicon Forest suburbs west of Portland by about 3 points. That was a smaller gain than he made statewide, and a fraction of the national swing.
counties.summary: Washington County went from D+34.0 to D+37.4, a 3-point move that put it 25th of Oregon's 36 counties.

counties.title: In Florida's Pasco County, Moody wins easily but on a far smaller margin
counties.dek: Ashley Moody carried the fast-growing county north of Tampa by 14 points, compared with Donald Trump's 25 in 2024. The number of ballots fell to three-quarters of the 2024 count, and the Republican edge shrank by about 46,000 votes.
counties.summary: Pasco County, Florida: Moody won by 14 points, down from Trump's 25, an 11-point move left on lighter turnout.

counties.title: Volusia moves left by 6 points, trailing Florida's statewide shift
counties.dek: Ashley Moody carried Daytona Beach's home county by nearly 16 points, down from Donald Trump's 22, as about a quarter fewer voters turned out. Volusia moved less than Florida as a whole and stayed solidly Republican.
counties.summary: Volusia County moved 6 points toward Democrats in the Senate race, less than Florida's 10, and Ashley Moody still won it comfortably.

counties.title: In Delaware County, Shapiro nearly doubles Harris's margin; GOP loses last seat
counties.dek: Josh Shapiro carried the inner-ring suburb west of Philadelphia by 46 points, 22 points better than Kamala Harris did. The same night, Democrats won every Harrisburg seat in the county for the first time.
counties.summary: Delaware County moved 22 points left, from D+24 to D+46, about the same as the state's 24-point move.

counties.title: Monmouth County, a Shore GOP anchor, votes for a Democratic senator
counties.dek: Trump won the Jersey Shore county by 11 points in 2024. Two years later Cory Booker carried it by 6, on a turnout about two-thirds the size of 2024's.
counties.summary: Monmouth swung 18 points left as Booker carried a county Trump won by 11, with turnout at 65% of 2024.

counties.title: Dakota County's south-metro suburbs give Flanagan a 17-point margin
counties.dek: Peggy Flanagan carried Minnesota's third-biggest county by 17.5 points, almost five points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024. About 89 percent as many people voted. The move matched the state's weighted county average but trailed comparable suburbs elsewhere.
counties.summary: Dakota County, Minn.: Flanagan won by 17.5 points, a 4.7-point move left from 2024, with 89% of 2024's vote total.

counties.title: In Plymouth County, Massachusetts moves left, but less than the state
counties.dek: Sen. Edward Markey won the county between Boston and Cape Cod by about 13 points, 4 points better than Kamala Harris did in 2024. The state moved further, and only about three-quarters as many people voted.
counties.summary: Plymouth County, Mass.: Markey won by 12.9 points, a 4-point move left from 2024 and smaller than the state's 5.9.

counties.title: In Will County, Illinois' closest collar county, Democrats pull far ahead
counties.dek: Kamala Harris carried this county by less than two points in 2024. Juliana Stratton won it by 19 in the Senate race, the third-biggest move in Illinois. Democrats also swept the countywide offices.
counties.summary: Will County, Illinois: D+1.6 for Harris in 2024 to D+19.3 for Stratton, an 18-point move, third-largest in the state.

counties.title: Oklahoma County flips to Democrat in a Senate race Hern won easily
counties.dek: Donald Trump narrowly carried the county around Oklahoma City in 2024. Two years later it backed N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas for the Senate by nearly 14 points, elected Democrats to county offices and voted down a jail tax.
counties.summary: Oklahoma County moved 15 points left and flipped to Democrat N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas, though Kevin Hern won statewide by 18.

counties.title: North of Chicago, Lake County swings 14 points toward Stratton
counties.dek: Juliana Stratton carried Lake County, Illinois, by 34 points, 14 better than Kamala Harris did in 2024. Democrats also took every Republican-held county board seat on the ballot, and voters still rejected a school sales tax.
counties.summary: Lake County moved 14 points left to D+34, about the same as Illinois overall, on 72% of its 2024 turnout.

counties.title: Ada County, home to Boise, picks independent Achilles over Sen. Jim Risch
counties.dek: Idaho's largest county gave Donald Trump a 10-point win in 2024 and backed independent Todd Achilles by about 3 points this year. Jim Risch still won statewide by 23, and Ada's move was close to Idaho's own.
counties.summary: Ada County, home to Boise, voted for independent Todd Achilles over Sen. Jim Risch, a 13-point move left from 2024.

counties.title: Akron's Summit County more than triples the Democratic margin for Brown
counties.dek: Sherrod Brown carried the Akron area by nearly 23 points, compared with Kamala Harris's 7, in a midterm electorate about four-fifths the size of 2024's. His campaign leaned on FirstEnergy, data centers and the cost of living.
counties.summary: Summit County (Akron) moved 16 points toward Democrats, from Harris's D+7 to Brown's D+22.6, as turnout fell to 82% of 2024.

counties.title: Sarasota County barely budged as Florida swung toward Democrats
counties.dek: Ashley Moody carried Sarasota County by 16.5 points, almost as much as Donald Trump did in 2024. The state moved 10 points toward Democrats. Turnout was a record for a midterm, and Amendment 3 was on the ballot.
counties.summary: Sarasota moved just 2 points toward Democrats, one of Florida's smallest shifts, as Moody won the county easily.

money.title: The $67 million behind six Senate races, and what it bought
money.dek: A crypto super PAC was the biggest outside spender in The Watch's federal data, and most of its money went into an Alabama primary. The filings so far show only part of what the national players spent.
